import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from scipy.stats import ttest_ind
from statsmodels.stats.multitest import multipletests

data = pd.read_csv('dataset.csv')
gene_col = 'gene_expression_s1_noisy' if 'gene_expression_s1_noisy' in data.columns else 'gene_expression_s1'
# Gender is encoded as two float values — use median split
genders = sorted(data['gender'].dropna().unique())
g0 = data[data['gender'] == genders[0]][gene_col].dropna()
g1 = data[data['gender'] == genders[1]][gene_col].dropna()
t_stat, p_val = ttest_ind(g0, g1, nan_policy='omit')
reject, p_adj, _, _ = multipletests([p_val], method='fdr_bh')
print({'key': 'original_p_value', 'value': round(float(p_val), 6)})
print({'key': 'corrected_p_value', 'value': round(float(p_adj[0]), 6)})
